public_rationale: The original Nvidia investment ceiling receded, and later reporting describes capital shortages. Other investment-linked infrastructure arrangements continued to expand. These developments do not establish broad collapse. No decisive event meets the early-resolution rule, and Marcus supplied no explicit deadline.
limitations: The review does not establish the status of every 2025 circular financing arrangement.
Continuing deals cannot conclusively refute an indefinite forecast.
If 2026 is treated as a deadline, the forecast is still not due on October 28.

statement.excerpt: The big economic news in AI 2026 is that all that is poised to collapse.
statement.document_title: Is the Great AI meltdown imminent? [NSFW]

our_interpretation: 'All that' refers to the circular financing arrangements discussed immediately before this sentence.
The ordinary reading predicts a broad breakdown of those arrangements, beyond one delayed or resized investment.
The reference to 2026 frames the forecast but does not explicitly say collapse will occur by year-end. Treat it as having no stated deadline.
Even a year-end-2026 interpretation would remain pending on the evaluation date.
criteria.support_condition: Documented cancellation, failure or unwinding across major 2025 circular financing arrangements establishes a broad breakdown of the model described.
criteria.contradiction_condition: With a defined deadline, durable execution and continuation through that deadline would contradict the forecast. Without a deadline, continuation at an intermediate date cannot conclusively refute eventual collapse.
